name: D&D Dungeon Map Generator (10 PRINT style)

mentions.name: D&D Dungeon Map Generator (10 PRINT style)
mentions.description: A web-based generator that creates old-school Dungeons & Dragons dungeon maps using Commodore 10 PRINT ("10 Print Chr$(205.5+Rnd(1)); : Goto 10") style maze logic, implemented in TypeScript, Svelte, and SVG. It focuses on realistic stair placement and ensuring the generated grid connects properly.
